ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Figure A is the contour topographic map of this uninhabited sea island, with a contour interval of 25 meters, and the four observation points ①②③④ are marked in the figure. ① is located in the southwest part of the island, near the relatively high closed contour line and near the mountain top; ③ is located near the northwest edge of the island, and the contour lines around it, especially toward the interior of the island, are relatively dense, indicating that the slope is relatively steep; ② is located near the eastern edge of the island, close to the coastline, and although there are undulations toward the interior of the island, the obstruction is relatively less concentrated than at ③; ④ is located in the southern part inside the island, relatively close to the central part, and observation can be carried out in multiple directions around it. Reasoning: To judge the size of the observation area, one must look at the height of the viewpoint and surrounding terrain obstruction. The position of ① is relatively high, there are few obstructions around it, and the field of view is relatively open; ④ is relatively close to the central part inside the island and can observe in multiple directions; although ② is on the eastern edge, the degree to which the line of sight toward the island interior is obstructed is not as serious as at ③. ③ is at a low place on the northwest edge, directly next to relatively steep high ground with dense contour lines, and when observing toward the island interior, the line of sight is quickly blocked by higher hillslopes or ridges, so the range that can be seen is mainly limited to a small nearby area. Therefore, among the four places, the one with the smallest area for observing the island is ③.

raw_record.question_text:
A school geography interest group went to an uninhabited sea island in Fujian Province to conduct field investigation activities. Figure A is the contour topographic map of the island, and Figure B is a photo taken by a student. Complete the following question accordingly.

<image1>

When standing at the four places in the figure to observe the island, which place has the smallest observation area?

method.method_draft: 先描述图甲的等高线分布和四个点的位置。以每个点为视点，沿通向岛内各方向作视线判断：若视线途中遇到比视点高、且等高线密集的山坡/山脊，则其后的区域不可见。①位于较高闭合等高线附近，遮挡少；④较靠岛内，可向多方向观察；②虽在东侧边缘，但面向岛内的遮挡相对不如③严重。③在西北边缘低处，旁边就是较陡的高地，通向岛内的大部分视线很快被山坡挡住，只能看到附近小范围。因此观测该岛面积最小的是③。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图甲是该无人海岛的等高线地形图，等高距为25米，图中标出①②③④四个观测点。①位于岛的西南部，靠近较高的闭合等高线和山顶附近；③位于岛的西北边缘附近，周围尤其向岛内方向等高线较密，说明坡度较陡；②位于岛的东侧边缘附近，靠近海岸线，向岛内虽有起伏但遮挡相对不如③集中；④位于岛内偏南、较靠中部的位置，周围可向多个方向展开观察。
推理：判断观测面积大小要看视点高度及周围地形遮挡。①位置较高，周围遮挡少，视野较开阔；④在岛内较靠中部，可向多方向观察；②虽然在东侧边缘，但向岛内视线受阻程度不如③严重。③在西北边缘低处，旁边紧邻等高线密集的较陡高地，向岛内观察时视线很快被较高山坡或山脊阻挡，能看到的范围主要限于附近小区域。因此四地中观测该岛面积最小的是③。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the visibility rule on contour maps: from an observation point, land behind a higher intervening ridge or slope is hidden; higher and less-obstructed positions generally see a larger area, while low edge positions behind nearby high ground see less.

raw_record.original_question:
某学校地理兴趣小组到福建省某无人海岛进行野外考察活动。图甲为该岛等高线地形图，图乙为某同学拍摄的照片，据此完成下题。

<image1>

站在图中四地观测该岛时，观测面积最小的地点是哪里？

Reasoning: To judge the size of the observation area, one must look at the height of the viewpoint and surrounding terrain obstruction. The position of ① is relatively high, there are few obstructions around it, and the field of view is relatively open; ④ is relatively close to the central part inside the island and can observe in multiple directions; although ② is on the eastern edge, the degree to which the line of sight toward the island interior is obstructed is not as serious as at ③. ③ is at a low place on the northwest edge, directly next to relatively steep high ground with dense contour lines, and when observing toward the island interior, the line of sight is quickly blocked by higher hillslopes or ridges, so the range that can be seen is mainly limited to a small nearby area. Therefore, among the four places, the one with the smallest area for observing the island is ③.

该推理轨迹整体通过。它先描述图甲/图乙的可见信息，再基于海拔、边缘位置和等高线密集程度推理，顺序符合“先描述图像，再推理”。最终答案为③，与标准答案一致，且基本遵循方法草稿。若需更严谨，可将“①海拔优势最明显/最高”表述为“①位于多条闭合等高线附近，海拔较高”，避免在未逐条读出所有高程时过度绝对化；同时可补充说明③附近密集等高线位于其岛内一侧，因而对其向岛内观测形成遮挡。
